# Tactics fixtures (copied — do not edit)

Verbatim copy of PV-1's Ascent tactical knowledge base.

- **Origin:** `origin/claude/pv-research @ 0f9e488` `datasets/derived/tactics/ascent-tactics.json`
- **Schema:** `datasets/catalog/schema/tactic.schema.json`; mapping `docs/research/ASCENT_TACTICS.md`
- **Copied:** 2026-11-18 by PV-3

8 attack + 9 defense Ascent tactics, each with zones/route/utilityRequirements/minPlayers/
provenance. **Provenance grades** (`provenanceLegend`): navgraph-derived, official,
reputable-analysis, expert-knowledge-unsourced. Most elements are
`expert-knowledge-unsourced` (standard pro/community knowledge, no single citable URL, **no
frequency claim**) — the decision trace surfaces the grade for the coach-note UI. Do not
edit; re-copy if upstream changes.
